name: Codebase orientation
prompt: Produce a bounded orientation map of this repository WITHOUT a recursive whole-tree scan: (1) the top-level component directories and what each owns (one line each); (2) where the CI workflow and required checks live; (3) where the money-path invariants are enforced (detection -> execution -> reconciliation); (4) the test layout and how to run the primary test suites; (5) the Production read-only entry points available to you. Use exact-path and symbol lookup, bounded search, and changed-files delta — not full-tree enumeration. Report file:line evidence per claim.

correctness: Component map covers the real top-level layout with one-line ownership
CI location and required-check set identified correctly
Money-path invariant enforcement points located with file:line refs
Test layout and run commands correct
